title: Chermoula baked cod
summary: Chermoula baked cod is a middle eastern dinner built around cod fillets and fresh coriander, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Chermoula baked cod into even pieces and toss fresh coriander with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of fresh coriander while you season cod fillets. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle cod fillets and garlic among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Chermoula baked cod before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Chermoula baked cod into warm bowls with the juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
